name: Hidden Spiked Pit
source: Pathfinder Adventure: A Few Flowers More

stealth.note: (trained) or DC 0 if the trapdoor is disabled or broken

description: A wooden trapdoor covers a pit that's 10 feet square and 20 feet deep. Knives are arrayed at the bottom of the trap, impaling anyone who falls on them.
reset: Creatures can still fall into the trap, but the trapdoor must be reset manually for the trap to become Hidden again.

offensiveAbilities.name: Pitfall
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature walks onto the trapdoor

Effect The triggering creature falls in and takes falling damage (10 Bludgeoning Damage damage) as well as 2d6 Piercing Damage damage from falling on to the knives. That creature can use the Grab an Edge reaction to avoid falling.
